text:
maria: Heads up — console invoice previews are showing sudden credit spikes for a small subset of tenants. I traced it back to the ingest handoff between the edge router and the metering fanout.
ajay: On it. Any repro steps or a sample trace?
maria: I pulled a trace: `router -> enrich -> fanout` latency spikes to ~2s and I see `x-tenant-route` headers arriving empty. Example log line: `edge: req_id=r_abc headers={x-tenant-route: ""}`
sam: That empty header rings a bell. We changed the proxy buffer behavior in PR #842 last week — could be truncation.
olivia: Console only shows ghost credits in PREVIEW, final invoices look fine for affected tenants. So preview pipeline may be using a different path/version.
maria: Yep. In staging the preview path uses the new fanout producer while final uses the stable one. I bisected: small fanout (2 shards) doesn't reproduce, bigger fanout does.
luca: Scale dependent — might be a serialization boundary in the fanout producer where a field shift causes header offset to be read wrong.
ajay: Here is a raw event we captured: `{"req_id":"r_abc","route":"","tokens":45}` — route is empty and downstream tagging assigns default free-tier tag.
maria: Quick repro script I used: `for i in {1..1000}; do curl -H 'x-tenant-route: t'$RANDOM http://edge/ingest; done` — will reproduce within a few minutes on canary.
sam: Short-term mitigation: revert proxy buffer change to 8192. I'll open a rollback PR now.
olivia: UX note — should add a console banner: "Preview may be stale for a small fraction of requests while we roll back an ingest change." Avoids customer confusion.
maria: Also suggest a telemetry alert: percent of events with empty `route` > 0.1% for 5m.
billing-bot: Alert created: `metering.route-missing > 0.1%` (scope: all-regions).
ajay: I instrumented the producer to log header lengths and uploaded the trace: `s3://redwood-debug/6950012345/trace.log`
luca: If it's proto/serialization related, check `fanout.serialize()` — we added an optional proto field recently that could shift varint boundaries.
maria: Suspect commit `c7f9b` from the proto refactor. Can someone bisect that commit range?
sam: I'll bisect tonight and report. If we confirm, we need a hotfix and a test coverage add.
olivia: UX decision needed: pause preview recompute until fix lands? Pros: no new confusing previews. Cons: removes quick feedback for customers.
maria: Proposal: show banner + drop preview sampling from 100% -> 5% until we have a fix. Less noisy and still provides some feedback.
ajay: Pushing preview sampling config to canary now.
maria: Thanks — keep updates here.
sam: Bisect result: confirmed `c7f9b` introduced an off-by-one in varint encoding when serializing optional strings. Creating revert PR.
ajay: Revert deployed to canary, traces now contain `x-tenant-route` again.
billing-bot: Deployment event: `revert-proto-enc-c7f9b` by sam deployed to canary at 6950012300. Monitors: green.
olivia: :thumbsup: I'll keep the banner until we validate on final and then remove it.
maria: Postmortem action items: 1) add `route-missing` alert + dashboard card, 2) add proto serialization unit tests, 3) add console sampling toggle for previews, 4) document revert in changelog and run a canary for 24h.
ajay: Added tasks to sprint board and flagged for oncall pairing.
maria: Closing the immediate loop — reopen if preview spikes reappear.
